subject: Marketing
preamble: The Marketing syllabus at the Senior Secondary School level in Nigeria is designed to assess candidates' basic knowledge, practical skills, and understanding of marketing concepts. It encompasses an overview of marketing principles, the marketing mix, consumer and organizational buyer behavior, market research, channel management, international trade, electronic marketing, and marketing-focused entrepreneurship.
aims: Assess knowledge, practical skills, and foundational concepts needed to pursue marketing as a career;
Evaluate ability to set up, fund, locate, and effectively manage a retail or commercial market outlet;
Examine understanding of the crucial roles marketing plays in economic development and resource distribution.
requirements: Candidates must take both Paper 1 and Paper 2 as a composite paper administered at a single sitting.
Candidates are expected to demonstrate practical skills in product design and the production of sample advertisements as part of their coursework preparation.

examination_scheme.summary: The examination consists of two composite papers (Paper 1 and Paper 2) taken at a single sitting, assessing objective recall, analytical essay writing, and practical application of marketing concepts.

papers.title: Objective Test
papers.details: Consists of forty compulsory multiple-choice objective questions covering the entire breadth of the syllabus.

papers.title: Essay Test
papers.details: Consists of six essay questions, out of which candidates are expected to answer any four questions carrying 20 marks each.

topics.title: 1. Introduction to Marketing
topics.notes: Meaning of marketing. Basic terms: needs, wants, demands, product, exchange, transactions, and markets. Historical development of marketing in Nigeria. Primary and secondary functions of marketing.

topics.title: 2. Marketing Concepts
topics.notes: Meaning and evolution of marketing philosophies: Production, Product, Selling, Marketing, and Societal Marketing concepts.

topics.title: 3. Marketing Mix and Marketing Environment
topics.notes: Meaning and elements of the Marketing Mix (4 Ps: Product, Price, Place, Promotion). Definition of the Marketing Environment and internal/external factors affecting it: political, cultural, religious, economic, technological, and social influences.

topics.title: 1. Products & Design
topics.notes: Definition and classification of products: Industrial goods, consumer goods, services, primary and secondary products, and mineral products (oil and non-oil). Key distinctions between product classes. Practical applications of Product Design.

topics.title: 2. Markets & Consumer/Organizational Behaviour
topics.notes: Definition and classifications of markets: Consumer and Organizational (industrial, reseller, and government). Consumer and organizational buying behavior: influencing factors and the consumer decision-making process in logical sequence.

topics.title: 3. Pricing Strategies
topics.notes: Meaning of pricing. Determinants of price. Pricing strategies (haggling, cost-plus, demand-based, and competition-based) and their practical applications.

topics.title: 1. Advertising
topics.notes: Definition and functions of advertising. Advertising media: types, advantages, and disadvantages. Practical production of sample advertisements.

topics.title: 2. Sales Promotion
topics.notes: Meaning and functions of sales promotion. Forms of promotional techniques: price-off, coupons, sales force competitions, loyalty schemes, premium offers, trade-in allowances, sampling, training schemes, and merchandising incentives.

topics.title: 3. Merchandising
topics.notes: Meaning, elements (packaging, branding, and labeling), influencing factors, and core functions of merchandising.

topics.title: 1. Distribution & Channels
topics.notes: Definition of distribution and channels of distribution. Types of distribution channels, factors influencing channel choice, and functions of channel intermediaries.

topics.title: 2. Transportation & Warehousing
topics.notes: Transportation: meaning, modes, choices, importance, factors influencing selection, and essential documentation. Warehousing: meaning, types, functions, and key warehouse operational activities.

topics.title: 3. Market Unions and Facilitators
topics.notes: Market Unions: meaning, types, and roles in local markets. Market Facilitators: meaning, types, and supporting functions in commerce.

topics.title: 4. Marketing Planning and Research
topics.notes: Meaning, process, importance, elements, and data requirements for marketing planning. Reasons for marketing planning and research, and practical utilization of market feedback.

topics.title: 1. International Marketing
topics.notes: Meaning, importance, reasons, and entry methods for international marketing. Environmental influencing factors and guiding regulatory frameworks.

topics.title: 2. ICT in Marketing (E-Marketing)
topics.notes: Electronic marketing (E-Marketing): definition, importance, practical uses, ethical considerations, and common abuses.

topics.title: 3. Entrepreneurship in Marketing
topics.notes: Definitions of entrepreneurship and entrepreneur. Sources of business funding. Factors affecting the location of market outlets. Outlets management: purchasing, supply chain, inventory, and practical selling and bargaining skills.

books: Fundamentals of Marketing by O. O. Shokan - MAM Education Limited, Lagos
Commerce Textbook by G. A. Saka and J. O. Nnabuko - Emiola Publisher Ltd
